extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (Linux Desktop) (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for Linux Desktop. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for Linux Desktop. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news:
v1.0.2 (2026-09-13)
- Added progress dialog with percentage display during custom profile bulk import - Custom import can now be cancelled mid-run (Cancel button stops further imports cleanly) - Prevent duplicate FriendlyName headers when source config already contains one - Drastically faster post-connect metadata verification (single ping probe, tighter curl timeouts, no retry delays) - DNS leak test now shows a progress dialog and refuses to run while the firewall killswitch is active - Fixed custom profiles not claiming the default route (ip4-auto-default-route now enabled, matching Mullvad behavior)
